title: [HR MEMO] UNDERWORLD DESK ENFORCES MANDATORY 6-MONTH RTO POLICY; CITES POMEGRANATE-SEED BINDING AGREEMENT
summary: After Persephone successfully negotiated a remote-work arrangement in the surface-level biosphere, Hades management executed a legacy contract clause triggered by the accidental consumption of six pomegranate seeds. She is now legally bound to a six-month localized sprint in the Tartarus facility. HR insists the mandatory subterranean Return-To-Office is essential for "preserving company culture," entirely ignoring the fact that ambient life actively decays upon entering the premises.
author: THE ORACLE / UNDERWORLD DESK
